question: A Clone enters as a copy of a face-down Grinning Demon. Can its controller pay {2}{B}{B} to turn the Clone face up?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the Clone is a face-up colorless 2/2 with no name, types or abilities, so it has no morph cost to pay.
expected.answer: Clone enters the battlefield as a copy of a face-down Grinning Demon (a creature with morph {2}{B}{B}). The Clone is a colorless 2/2 creature with no name, no types, no abilities, and no mana cost. It will still be face up. Its controller can’t pay {2}{B}{B} to turn it face up.
